fact: The Sudanese Standards and Metrology Organization (SSMO) publishes an online catalogue of adopted Sudanese Standards, each with its number and year and its ISO equivalent where there is one; the page carries no date, so the retrieval date 2026-08-29 is used.
SSMO's catalogue lists item 40, an information technology standard on yield of toner cartridges for monochrome printers, Sudanese Standard 4469:2018, equivalent to ISO 19752:2017.

SSMO's catalogue lists item 16, 'the digital repository', Sudanese Standard 6392:2019, and item 49, an information and documentation standard on open systems interconnection application protocol, Sudanese Standard 1841-2:2016 (ISO 10161-2:2014).

SSMO's catalogue lists item 10, records metadata management part 1, Sudanese Standard 1633-1:2015 (ISO 23081-1:2006), and item 31, financial card message characteristics part 3, Sudanese Standard 6422-3:2020 (ISO 8583-3:1998).

The Sudanese Standards and Metrology Organization (SSMO) is reported operating, with a director general and a White Nile State branch that launched electronic fee collection through the Eysali system; the article does not say what law set it up and names no IT or data standard.

The Sudanese Standards and Metrology Organization (SSMO) is reported operating in Khartoum and piloting electronic payment of standards certification fees; the article does not say what law set it up and names no IT or data standard.
